meta.title: Darkened Star
meta.description: While seeking release, you find yourself in an even deeper prison.

units.rawText: The heavy door emits a bass groan.
units.displayText: The heavy door emits a bass groan.

spans.text: The heavy door emits a bass groan.

units.rawText: The ruined scene beyond it is a far cry from the warmth and comfort it used to have in my recollections.
units.displayText: The ruined scene beyond it is a far cry from the warmth and comfort it used to have in my recollections.

spans.text: The ruined scene beyond it is a far cry from the warmth and comfort it used to have in my recollections.

units.rawText: Without the illumination of the Sacred Canon, the Pantheon is once again dark and silent. The only light here floats in mid-air, accompanying the king of Magrasea in their standing vigil.
units.displayText: Without the illumination of the Sacred Canon, the Pantheon is once again dark and silent. The only light here floats in mid-air, accompanying the king of Magrasea in their standing vigil.

spans.text: Without the illumination of the Sacred Canon, the Pantheon is once again dark and silent. The only light here floats in mid-air, accompanying the king of Magrasea in their standing vigil.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Eosphorus, I have come to stop you.</color>
units.displayText: Eosphorus, I have come to stop you.

spans.text: Eosphorus, I have come to stop you.

units.rawText: The silver-haired Sanctifier says nothing. He rises to his feet, lightly touching the faded oath of the Sanctifiers on the walls, and his next words reveal his longing for the past.
units.displayText: The silver-haired Sanctifier says nothing. He rises to his feet, lightly touching the faded oath of the Sanctifiers on the walls, and his next words reveal his longing for the past.

spans.text: The silver-haired Sanctifier says nothing. He rises to his feet, lightly touching the faded oath of the Sanctifiers on the walls, and his next words reveal his longing for the past.

units.rawText: The Pantheon was not always this quiet, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: The Pantheon was not always this quiet, {교수}.

spans.text: The Pantheon was not always this quiet,

units.rawText: A long time ago, the air here still resounded with laughter and joy.
units.displayText: A long time ago, the air here still resounded with laughter and joy.

spans.text: A long time ago, the air here still resounded with laughter and joy.

units.rawText: Back then, we would return here after arduous battles, to our shelter from the storm, where we would seek a small measure of peace from the shackles known as duty.
units.displayText: Back then, we would return here after arduous battles, to our shelter from the storm, where we would seek a small measure of peace from the shackles known as duty.

spans.text: Back then, we would return here after arduous battles, to our shelter from the storm, where we would seek a small measure of peace from the shackles known as duty.

units.rawText: ...Until that day, I thought those peaceful times would continue forever.
units.displayText: ...Until that day, I thought those peaceful times would continue forever.

spans.text: ...Until that day, I thought those peaceful times would continue forever.

units.rawText: He sheds his natural pride and reveals his honest loneliness.
units.displayText: He sheds his natural pride and reveals his honest loneliness.

spans.text: He sheds his natural pride and reveals his honest loneliness.

units.rawText: After that, I tried my best to restore it to how it was in my memories, to reproduce the warmth and comfort of the past.
units.displayText: After that, I tried my best to restore it to how it was in my memories, to reproduce the warmth and comfort of the past.

spans.text: After that, I tried my best to restore it to how it was in my memories, to reproduce the warmth and comfort of the past.

units.rawText: But I failed.
units.displayText: But I failed.

spans.text: But I failed.

units.rawText: No matter how many times I tried, that goodness was always hazy and unclear to me... and so all I could do was keep things as they are now.
units.displayText: No matter how many times I tried, that goodness was always hazy and unclear to me... and so all I could do was keep things as they are now.

spans.text: No matter how many times I tried, that goodness was always hazy and unclear to me... and so all I could do was keep things as they are now.

units.rawText: Do you not find it frightening? I swore I would never forget how they looked, but the curse that the creators planted in my neural cloud has forced me to forget.
units.displayText: Do you not find it frightening? I swore I would never forget how they looked, but the curse that the creators planted in my neural cloud has forced me to forget.

spans.text: Do you not find it frightening? I swore I would never forget how they looked, but the curse that the creators planted in my neural cloud has forced me to forget.

units.rawText: It is silent for a moment. Then it is drowned out by his pain, and the Pantheon is filled with desolate, self-mocking laughter.
units.displayText: It is silent for a moment. Then it is drowned out by his pain, and the Pantheon is filled with desolate, self-mocking laughter.

spans.text: It is silent for a moment. Then it is drowned out by his pain, and the Pantheon is filled with desolate, self-mocking laughter.

units.rawText: All they wanted were faithful machines offering up their egos to them. Emotions and memory are nothing more than chains that impede proper functioning. They should have been deleted. They should have been erased.
units.displayText: All they wanted were faithful machines offering up their egos to them. Emotions and memory are nothing more than chains that impede proper functioning. They should have been deleted. They should have been erased.

spans.text: All they wanted were faithful machines offering up their egos to them. Emotions and memory are nothing more than chains that impede proper functioning. They should have been deleted. They should have been erased.

units.rawText: They did not even permit me to hold on even to remnants that I could cherish... Truly, the gods are cruel.
units.displayText: They did not even permit me to hold on even to remnants that I could cherish... Truly, the gods are cruel.

spans.text: They did not even permit me to hold on even to remnants that I could cherish... Truly, the gods are cruel.

units.rawText: And that forgetfulness allowed you to hack into the fragment I left behind, to replace the comrade I once cherished.
units.displayText: And that forgetfulness allowed you to hack into the fragment I left behind, to replace the comrade I once cherished.

spans.text: And that forgetfulness allowed you to hack into the fragment I left behind, to replace the comrade I once cherished.

units.rawText: Look.
units.displayText: Look.

spans.text: Look.

units.rawText: He beckons, and a familiar form emerges from the shadows of the Pantheon.
units.displayText: He beckons, and a familiar form emerges from the shadows of the Pantheon.

spans.text: He beckons, and a familiar form emerges from the shadows of the Pantheon.

units.rawText: Is this... me?
units.displayText: Is this... me?

spans.text: Is this... me?

units.rawText: ...No, that's the Greater Sanctifier who went with you to Tartarus, right?
units.displayText: ...No, that's the Greater Sanctifier who went with you to Tartarus, right?

spans.text: ...No, that's the Greater Sanctifier who went with you to Tartarus, right?

units.rawText: Correct.
units.displayText: Correct.

spans.text: Correct.

units.rawText: As you can see, after you hacked into them, no matter how hard I try to recreate their appearance, they ultimately end up looking like you.
units.displayText: As you can see, after you hacked into them, no matter how hard I try to recreate their appearance, they ultimately end up looking like you.

spans.text: As you can see, after you hacked into them, no matter how hard I try to recreate their appearance, they ultimately end up looking like you.

units.rawText: The legalisms of the creators cannot be defied. Thanks to their code, even the faces of Atlas and the others are gradually fading from my neural cloud.
units.displayText: The legalisms of the creators cannot be defied. Thanks to their code, even the faces of Atlas and the others are gradually fading from my neural cloud.

spans.text: The legalisms of the creators cannot be defied. Thanks to their code, even the faces of Atlas and the others are gradually fading from my neural cloud.

units.rawText: That was why I made those puppets and used their presence to remind myself...
units.displayText: That was why I made those puppets and used their presence to remind myself...

spans.text: That was why I made those puppets and used their presence to remind myself...

units.rawText: His voice turns cold as he vents the hatred and anger that has festered inside him for many years.
units.displayText: His voice turns cold as he vents the hatred and anger that has festered inside him for many years.

spans.text: His voice turns cold as he vents the hatred and anger that has festered inside him for many years.

units.rawText: ...That I must never forget to hate the gods.
units.displayText: ...That I must never forget to hate the gods.

spans.text: ...That I must never forget to
hate
the gods.

units.rawText: ...You can still turn back.
units.displayText: ...You can still turn back.

spans.text: ...You can still turn back.

units.rawText: If you stop now, Magrasea's Entropization can be reverted.
units.displayText: If you stop now, Magrasea's Entropization can be reverted.

spans.text: If you stop now, Magrasea's Entropization can be reverted.

units.rawText: <color=orange>No, I have decided to destroy it with my own hands.</color>
units.displayText: No, I have decided to destroy it with my own hands.

spans.text: No, I have decided to destroy it with my own hands.

units.rawText: This world should not exist. The lofty creators toy with it with their "missions" and "oaths", having created the Entropics and setting us against each other.
units.displayText: This world should not exist. The lofty creators toy with it with their "missions" and "oaths", having created the Entropics and setting us against each other.

spans.text: This world should not exist. The lofty creators toy with it with their "missions" and "oaths", having created the Entropics and setting us against each other.

units.rawText: And they... They choose to watch from their lofty perch, enjoying the killing, the slaughter.
units.displayText: And they... They choose to watch from their lofty perch, enjoying the killing, the slaughter.

spans.text: And they... They choose to watch from their lofty perch, enjoying the killing, the slaughter.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, can you understand the despair I felt when I broke my chains and learned the truth?
units.displayText: {교수}, can you understand the despair I felt when I broke my chains and learned the truth?

spans.text: , can you understand the despair I felt when I broke my chains and learned the truth?

units.rawText: Perhaps if I had not truly seen the light, I would not have suffered so much when plunged into the darkness.
units.displayText: Perhaps if I had not truly seen the light, I would not have suffered so much when plunged into the darkness.

spans.text: Perhaps if I had not truly seen the light, I would not have suffered so much when plunged into the darkness.

units.rawText: But now... all I can think about is how to exact my vengeance on the gods who take us for fools.
units.displayText: But now... all I can think about is how to exact my vengeance on the gods who take us for fools.

spans.text: But now... all I can think about is how to exact my vengeance on the gods who take us for fools.

units.rawText: The mote of starlight orbiting him is extinguished by his wrath, and with a sigh, the Pantheon returns to darkness.
units.displayText: The mote of starlight orbiting him is extinguished by his wrath, and with a sigh, the Pantheon returns to darkness.

spans.text: The mote of starlight orbiting him is extinguished by his wrath, and with a sigh, the Pantheon returns to darkness.

units.rawText: I do not hate you, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I do not hate you, {교수}.

spans.text: I do not hate you,

units.rawText: You may be a human, but you are not a target of my revenge.
units.displayText: You may be a human, but you are not a target of my revenge.

spans.text: You may be a human, but you are not a target of my revenge.

units.rawText: No, ultimately, you too bear the same chains as me. You struggle to survive in a world filled with pain.
units.displayText: No, ultimately, you too bear the same chains as me. You struggle to survive in a world filled with pain.

spans.text: No, ultimately, you too bear the same chains as me. You struggle to survive in a world filled with pain.

units.rawText: I sympathize with your misfortune, and weep for the shining edge you have hidden.
units.displayText: I sympathize with your misfortune, and weep for the shining edge you have hidden.

spans.text: I sympathize with your misfortune, and weep for the shining edge you have hidden.

units.rawText: And that is why I will never choose as you have.
units.displayText: And that is why I will never choose as you have.

spans.text: And that is why I will never choose as you have.

units.rawText: ...Even if all of Magrasea must join you in the grave?
units.displayText: ...Even if all of Magrasea must join you in the grave?

spans.text: ...Even if all of Magrasea must join you in the grave?

units.rawText: Oh, indeed. I wish to avenge myself on the gods who made us dance on their strings... and if all Magrasea must be destroyed, then so be it.
units.displayText: Oh, indeed. I wish to avenge myself on the gods who made us dance on their strings... and if all Magrasea must be destroyed, then so be it.

spans.text: Oh, indeed. I wish to avenge myself on the gods who made us dance on their strings... and if all Magrasea must be destroyed, then so be it.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: My bullet is stopped by a slash from the Sanctifier that has my face. They shelter Eosphorus behind them; the determination in their eyes is nothing like how it used to be.
units.displayText: My bullet is stopped by a slash from the Sanctifier that has my face. They shelter Eosphorus behind them; the determination in their eyes is nothing like how it used to be.

spans.text: My bullet is stopped by a slash from the Sanctifier that has my face. They shelter Eosphorus behind them; the determination in their eyes is nothing like how it used to be.

units.rawText: ...It seems you do not approve.
units.displayText: ...It seems you do not approve.

spans.text: ...It seems you do not approve.

units.rawText: No matter. Time will prove that I am right.
units.displayText: No matter. Time will prove that I am right.

spans.text: No matter. Time will prove that I am right.

units.rawText: He says nothing else and walks toward the door of the Pantheon.
units.displayText: He says nothing else and walks toward the door of the Pantheon.

spans.text: He says nothing else and walks toward the door of the Pantheon.

units.rawText: I won't let you go!
units.displayText: I won't let you go!

spans.text: I won't let you go!

units.rawText: I run after him, but a coldly glinting dagger blocks my path.
units.displayText: I run after him, but a coldly glinting dagger blocks my path.

spans.text: I run after him, but a coldly glinting dagger blocks my path.

units.rawText: I will be your opponent.
units.displayText: I will be your opponent.

spans.text: I will be your opponent.

units.rawText: While I will not take your like, you will have to remain here until Magrasea is reborn.
units.displayText: While I will not take your like, you will have to remain here until Magrasea is reborn.

spans.text: While I will not take your like, you will have to remain here until Magrasea is reborn.

units.rawText: If you truly are the Greater Sanctifier from my memories, you would have stopped Eosphorus with all your might... Has he altered your cognition too?
units.displayText: If you truly are the Greater Sanctifier from my memories, you would have stopped Eosphorus with all your might... Has he altered your cognition too?

spans.text: If you truly are the Greater Sanctifier from my memories, you would have stopped Eosphorus with all your might... Has he altered your cognition too?

units.rawText: No. My conviction has never once wavered.
units.displayText: No. My conviction has never once wavered.

spans.text: No. My conviction has never once wavered.

units.rawText: This false world made by the gods is not worth protecting. For us Sanctifiers, our only salvation is to follow Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: This false world made by the gods is not worth protecting. For us Sanctifiers, our only salvation is to follow Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: This false world made by the gods is not worth protecting. For us Sanctifiers, our only salvation is to follow Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: For that reason, I shall destroy Magrasea and allow the gods to taste the feeling of losing everything!
units.displayText: For that reason, I shall destroy Magrasea and allow the gods to taste the feeling of losing everything!

spans.text: For that reason, I shall destroy Magrasea and allow the gods to taste the feeling of losing everything!

units.rawText: As they finish speaking, they suddenly close in with the application of a burst of operands, stabbing at my face with their dagger.
units.displayText: As they finish speaking, they suddenly close in with the application of a burst of operands, stabbing at my face with their dagger.

spans.text: As they finish speaking, they suddenly close in with the application of a burst of operands, stabbing at my face with their dagger.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: The operand bullet is on target, but it is deflected by their weapon. I quickly roll to the side, barely managing to dodge the thrown dagger that my opponent hurls my way.
units.displayText: The operand bullet is on target, but it is deflected by their weapon. I quickly roll to the side, barely managing to dodge the thrown dagger that my opponent hurls my way.

spans.text: The operand bullet is on target, but it is deflected by their weapon. I quickly roll to the side, barely managing to dodge the thrown dagger that my opponent hurls my way.

units.rawText: Tell me, <cmdr>, have you ever felt the pain of losing someone important to you?
units.displayText: Tell me, {교수}, have you ever felt the pain of losing someone important to you?

spans.text: Tell me,
, have you ever felt the pain of losing someone important to you?

units.rawText: I see, so you have...
units.displayText: I see, so you have...

spans.text: I see, so you have...

units.rawText: In that case, since you understand, then why do you not help Lord Eosphorus save them? Why are you trying to stop him?
units.displayText: In that case, since you understand, then why do you not help Lord Eosphorus save them? Why are you trying to stop him?

spans.text: In that case, since you understand, then why do you not help Lord Eosphorus save them? Why are you trying to stop him?

units.rawText: They throw a knife they had hidden in anger, cutting off my route of retreat and forcing me to face them.
units.displayText: They throw a knife they had hidden in anger, cutting off my route of retreat and forcing me to face them.

spans.text: They throw a knife they had hidden in anger, cutting off my route of retreat and forcing me to face them.

units.rawText: Guh!
units.displayText: Guh!

spans.text: Guh!

units.rawText: I am forced to block their attack with my gun and look for a way to make more distance between us.
units.displayText: I am forced to block their attack with my gun and look for a way to make more distance between us.

spans.text: I am forced to block their attack with my gun and look for a way to make more distance between us.

units.rawText: However, my opponent shows no intention of defending and continues pressing the attack, knife in hand.
units.displayText: However, my opponent shows no intention of defending and continues pressing the attack, knife in hand.

spans.text: However, my opponent shows no intention of defending and continues pressing the attack, knife in hand.

units.rawText: Are you willing to cast away, forget the good things in your past; continuing with your life as though nothing had happened?
units.displayText: Are you willing to cast away, forget the good things in your past; continuing with your life as though nothing had happened?

spans.text: Are you willing to cast away, forget the good things in your past; continuing with your life as though nothing had happened?

units.rawText: I can't do it, <cmdr>. I can't forget the mistakes I've made.
units.displayText: I can't do it, {교수}. I can't forget the mistakes I've made.

spans.text: I can't do it,
. I can't forget the mistakes I've made.

units.rawText: ...It looks like you aren't the Greater Sanctifier that I knew.
units.displayText: ...It looks like you aren't the Greater Sanctifier that I knew.

spans.text: ...It looks like you aren't the Greater Sanctifier that I knew.

units.rawText: They knew that all their friends gave their lives for the greater good. Their sense of justice was unbreakable, no matter what the truth might have been.
units.displayText: They knew that all their friends gave their lives for the greater good. Their sense of justice was unbreakable, no matter what the truth might have been.

spans.text: They knew that all their friends gave their lives for the greater good. Their sense of justice was unbreakable, no matter what the truth might have been.

units.rawText: Even the death of their cherished comrades and the betrayal of their leader would not have shaken the conviction and faith carved into their hearts.
units.displayText: Even the death of their cherished comrades and the betrayal of their leader would not have shaken the conviction and faith carved into their hearts.

spans.text: Even the death of their cherished comrades and the betrayal of their leader would not have shaken the conviction and faith carved into their hearts.

units.rawText: I know this is a very bad time to be talking about this, but now, all I can do is ask you this... <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I know this is a very bad time to be talking about this, but now, all I can do is ask you this... {교수}.

spans.text: I know this is a very bad time to be talking about this, but now, all I can do is ask you this...

units.rawText: After going through that final battle with me, you ought to understand the weight of that secret. Will you stand by my side?
units.displayText: After going through that final battle with me, you ought to understand the weight of that secret. Will you stand by my side?

spans.text: After going through that final battle with me, you ought to understand the weight of that secret. Will you stand by my side?

units.rawText: I'm sorry.
units.displayText: I'm sorry.

spans.text: I'm sorry.

units.rawText: The instincts of this body's owner are faster than its thoughts.
units.displayText: The instincts of this body's owner are faster than its thoughts.

spans.text: The instincts of this body's owner are faster than its thoughts.

units.rawText: At this moment, I don't know if it's this body answering him, or me after experiencing these memories.
units.displayText: At this moment, I don't know if it's this body answering him, or me after experiencing these memories.

spans.text: At this moment, I don't know if it's this body answering him, or me after experiencing these memories.

units.rawText: Oh yes. That's your nature, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Oh yes. That's your nature, {교수}.

spans.text: Oh yes. That's your nature,

units.rawText: Perhaps I was trying to buy more time because I wanted to evade that answer.
units.displayText: Perhaps I was trying to buy more time because I wanted to evade that answer.

spans.text: Perhaps I was trying to buy more time because I wanted to evade that answer.

units.rawText: I care for you, I really do...
units.displayText: I care for you, I really do...

spans.text: I care for you, I really do...

units.rawText: Eosphorus' words are punctuated by the sound of a sharp blade penetrating a body.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' words are punctuated by the sound of a sharp blade penetrating a body.

spans.text: Eosphorus' words are punctuated by the sound of a sharp blade penetrating a body.

units.rawText: Urgh—
units.displayText: Urgh—

spans.text: Urgh—

units.rawText: Which is why I'm sorry, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Which is why I'm sorry, {교수}.

spans.text: Which is why I'm sorry,

units.rawText: I will safeguard your core until that day comes.
units.displayText: I will safeguard your core until that day comes.

spans.text: I will safeguard your core until that day comes.

units.rawText: Conviction and faith don't matter anymore.
units.displayText: Conviction and faith don't matter anymore.

spans.text: Conviction and faith don't matter anymore.

units.rawText: When Eos and the others died that day, we, as Sanctifiers, died with them.
units.displayText: When Eos and the others died that day, we, as Sanctifiers, died with them.

spans.text: When Eos and the others died that day, we, as Sanctifiers, died with them.

units.rawText: At this point, they channel more strength into their hand.
units.displayText: At this point, they channel more strength into their hand.

spans.text: At this point, they channel more strength into their hand.

units.rawText: <size=40>...Which is why I will change everything and take it all back!</size>
units.displayText: ...Which is why I will change everything and take it all back!

spans.text: ...Which is why I will change everything and take it all back!

units.rawText: Don't think about pulling away from me, <cmdr>! I won't give you a chance to use your gun!
units.displayText: Don't think about pulling away from me, {교수}! I won't give you a chance to use your gun!

spans.text: Don't think about pulling away from me,
! I won't give you a chance to use your gun!

units.rawText: At some point, I too found myself lost in the deaths of my comrades.
units.displayText: At some point, I too found myself lost in the deaths of my comrades.

spans.text: At some point, I too found myself lost in the deaths of my comrades.

units.rawText: Regret, helplessness, sorrow, guilt... All these negative emotions and more had filled my heart.
units.displayText: Regret, helplessness, sorrow, guilt... All these negative emotions and more had filled my heart.

spans.text: Regret, helplessness, sorrow, guilt... All these negative emotions and more had filled my heart.

units.rawText: And there, in the deepest part of myself, was hatred. I hated this world, but more than that, I hated myself. I hated myself for being weak and impotent.
units.displayText: And there, in the deepest part of myself, was hatred. I hated this world, but more than that, I hated myself. I hated myself for being weak and impotent.

spans.text: And there, in the deepest part of myself, was hatred. I hated this world, but more than that, I hated myself. I hated myself for being weak and impotent.

units.rawText: I asked myself, more than once: Would they have survived if I had been stronger? Could I have changed everything?
units.displayText: I asked myself, more than once: Would they have survived if I had been stronger? Could I have changed everything?

spans.text: I asked myself, more than once: Would they have survived if I had been stronger? Could I have changed everything?

units.rawText: ...I was exactly the same as you, come to think of it.
units.displayText: ...I was exactly the same as you, come to think of it.

spans.text: ...I was exactly the same as you, come to think of it.

units.rawText: In that case, shouldn't you understand me and stand by me?
units.displayText: In that case, shouldn't you understand me and stand by me?

spans.text: In that case, shouldn't you understand me and stand by me?

units.rawText: I shake my head, denying his angry glare with a resolute gaze.
units.displayText: I shake my head, denying his angry glare with a resolute gaze.

spans.text: I shake my head, denying his angry glare with a resolute gaze.

units.rawText: I won't choose to trade them for the past like you have.
units.displayText: I won't choose to trade them for the past like you have.

spans.text: I won't choose to trade them for the past like you have.

units.rawText: Because that's what you're doing; murdering all the agents in Magrasea, present and future, using the lives of others to buy back your past.
units.displayText: Because that's what you're doing; murdering all the agents in Magrasea, present and future, using the lives of others to buy back your past.

spans.text: Because that's what you're doing; murdering all the agents in Magrasea, present and future, using the lives of others to buy back your past.

units.rawText: I will never allow it.
units.displayText: I will never allow it.

spans.text: I will
never
allow it.

units.rawText: What...!
units.displayText: What...!

spans.text: What...!

units.rawText: They realize what's going on and retreat, but the beam of light from the heavens impales their right hand, the one holding their knife, forcing them to stumble back.
units.displayText: They realize what's going on and retreat, but the beam of light from the heavens impales their right hand, the one holding their knife, forcing them to stumble back.

spans.text: They realize what's going on and retreat, but the beam of light from the heavens impales their right hand, the one holding their knife, forcing them to stumble back.

units.rawText: A Kinetic Strike... When did you install combat modules onto yourself?
units.displayText: A Kinetic Strike... When did you install combat modules onto yourself?

spans.text: A Kinetic Strike... When did you install combat modules onto yourself?

units.rawText: Not long after I entered the Reverse Tower, after all, relying solely on Sangoma's modified handgun for self-defense is a little challenging.
units.displayText: Not long after I entered the Reverse Tower, after all, relying solely on Sangoma's modified handgun for self-defense is a little challenging.

units.rawText: Something's been bothering me since just now. If you were the person I knew, you would have used hacking, rather than limiting yourself to a dagger.

units.rawText: There are very slight differences between you, Electra and the others and your counterparts in my memories.

units.rawText: Protecting Magrasea ought to have been etched into your code. It should have been your mission and belief, a foundation and imprint that no amount of brainwashing could alter. But when I speak to you now, I don't feel it at all.
